review_checks.statement: The exact preflight baseline and current console implementation are hash-pinned.
All fourteen planned routes have stable identifiers, named source families, read-only authority and fallback states.
Card, status, empty-state and action registries are complete enough to begin fixture-only shell implementation.
No-signal health is not PASS and unknown status fails closed to BLOCK.
Repository, selector, threshold, release, classification, probability, exposure, execution and agent mutations remain prohibited.
Remote deployment is prohibited and the visual Deploy control is replaced by a non-clickable LOCAL badge.
Deferred research writes require a separate authority gate and cannot be activated by RC-WP1.
Canonical tests passed on the reviewed RC-00 head and RC-00 was squash-merged without force push.
